name_note: GTDB places this species in g__Alistipes_A, a split of the classical genus Alistipes; the literature uses the name Alistipes ihumii.

sentences.text: Alistipes ihumii is a Gram-negative anaerobic bacillus described as a species within the genus Alistipes.
Its type strain was isolated from the faecal flora of a 21-year-old French woman with a severe restrictive form of anorexia nervosa.
The genome of that strain is 2,753,264 base pairs long and contains 2,254 protein-coding genes.
In 144 adolescents aged 11 to 14 years, the association of Alistipes ihumii relative abundance with total cholesterol differed between female and male participants.
A study of acupuncture in atopic dermatitis reported that Alistipes ihumii was enriched in patients classed as responders by clinical improvement.
